name: Creepy Monkey Horror
summary: Creepy Monkey Horror invites players into a dark and mysterious world where the boundaries between reality and nightmare blur. Inspired by the unique gorilla locomotion mechanics found in Gorilla Tag, this game takes fear to new heights. As you step into the shoes of a daring explorer, prepare to traverse a variety of meticulously crafted maps, each hiding secrets, jump scares, and spine-chilling encounters.
